armOrder: counterbalanced: baseline first on even pair indices
baseline: clear application retrieval_cache before every measured original Memory.search call
candidate: clear application retrieval_cache, prime once with same original Memory.search, then measure 16 calls
timing: external time.perf_counter around each search only; excludes cache clearing, priming and corpus setup
eligibility: both arms complete, all requested queries retained, normalized output hashes equal
